STEP 1 LOAD PACKAGES
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(janitor)
library(countrycode)
library(here)
```

STEP 2 LOAD DATA AND CLEAN
```{r}
geni <- read_csv("hdr-data.csv")
countries <- st_read("World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson")
geni_diff <- geni %>% dplyr::select(countryIsoCode, year, value, country) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = value, names_prefix = "gii_") %>%
  mutate(gii_diff = gii_2019 - gii_2010)
countries <- countries %>%
  mutate(iso3 = countrycode(ISO, origin = "iso2c", destination = "iso3c"))
```

STEP 3 MERGE WITH SPATIAL DATA
```{r}
country_gii <- countries %>%
  merge(., geni_diff, by.x="iso3", by.y="countryIsoCode")
country_gii <- country_gii %>% select(-c(country, ISO)) %>% rename(ISO = iso3)
```

STEP 4 MAP THE DATA
```{r}
library(tmap)
tm_shape(country_gii) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "gii_diff",
              fill.scale  = tm_scale_intervals(style = "quantile", n = 5),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Change in Gender Inequality Index (2010 - 2019)"))
```
